name: Umar Hayat Chaska Point — Tala Naan, Samosay (Samosa) & Pakoray in Gujrat
description: Best tala naan (fried naan / besan wala naan), murgh chanay (murgh cholay), anday chanay (egg & chickpea curry), baingan pakora (eggplant fritters), aloo tikki, mirchi pakoda, samosay, pakoray (bhajia) and desi nashta in Gujrat, Punjab. Fresh oil every day. Order on WhatsApp.
